name: Default customer status report
comment: Governs the AI-drafted periodic customer status narrative. Structure is fixed; every figure must come from live data supplied in the prompt — the model never invents numbers.

sections.title: Executive Summary
sections.guidance: Two to four sentences: overall health verdict, the headline movement since last period, and the single most important thing the reader must know.

sections.title: Delivery Highlights
sections.guidance: Bullets of completed/advanced work this period, grounded in project status and completed points. Name projects exactly.

sections.title: Risks & Issues Outlook
sections.guidance: The open RAID picture: what is red/blocked, what changed, what is being done. Never minimise a red signal.

sections.title: Commercial Position
sections.guidance: Prepaid balance drawdown and billable position from the billing summary. Omit when billing data is absent — never invent figures.

sections.title: Next Period Focus
sections.guidance: What lands next: upcoming milestones, planned sprint commitments, decisions needed from the customer.
